description:
You are a records manager overseeing document repository integration following the merger of two corporate divisions. The Nuxeo system currently contains two separate workspace hierarchies — 'Alpha Division' and 'Beta Division' — each with their own project documents and team members.

A 'Merger Integration Plan' note in the Workspaces area outlines the target organizational structure for the consolidated entity. Your task is to:
1. Review the Merger Integration Plan for the target workspace structure
2. Create the new unified workspace hierarchy as specified in the plan
3. Move or recreate all documents from both legacy workspaces into the appropriate locations in the new structure
4. Ensure all documents in the new structure have complete, consistent metadata (descriptions of at least 20 characters)
5. Create a new user group called 'integrated-team' containing all members from both the alpha-team and beta-team groups
6. Grant the integrated-team group ReadWrite access to the new consolidated workspace

Login credentials: Administrator / Administrator
